# TME modulation in solid and immunotherapy-resistant tumours — evidence listing

261 curated records, 2002–2026. 118 (45%) explicitly address immunotherapy resistance, immune exclusion or cold-tumour biology; 112 have open-access full text mirrored under `fulltext/` (marked `FT`).

**Evidence mix** — Clinical trials: 74, Human translational: 21, Evidence synthesis: 1, Reviews: 70, Preclinical (in vivo): 75, Mechanistic: 20

**Disease context** — pan-solid: 88, melanoma: 45, nsclc: 27, gbm_cns: 25, breast: 22, pdac: 17, crc: 16, gu_other: 13, gyn: 8, rcc: 7, sarcoma_peds: 7, hcc_biliary: 6, gi_other: 5, hnscc: 2, mesothelioma: 1
